claims.text: A bug was reported where linting with an absolute path to a temporary file failed on macOS Catalina, resulting in ENOENT errors when writeFileSync attempted to open the file.
The failure was traced to the file path being passed to fs.writeFileSync as a relative path that did not resolve correctly on macOS Catalina’s changed root directory handling.
The suggested fix was to wrap the file path with path.resolve before calling writeFileSync, thereby normalizing it to an absolute path.
Pull request #4887 implemented this change by adding path.resolve to the writeFileSync call, and the change was committed in commit 8c2ac95.
Applying path.resolve eliminated the ENOENT errors on macOS Catalina, confirming that the normalized absolute path allowed writeFileSync to correctly write to temporary files.
